newsitem.title: FRANCE: Private sector operator for France's Vatry cargo airport.
newsitem.headline: Private sector operator for France's Vatry cargo airport.

text.p: French public authorities backing the development of an all-cargo airport, situated at Vatry, around 150 kilometres east of Paris, said they will present a list of six, private sector candidates to run the site at a press conference in Paris on April 22.

"Three are French and three are international operators - each with a significant presence in the freight transport sector," the semi-public company managing the project, Europort Vatry, said in a statement.
The Marne department local authority investing one billion francs over the next two years in transforming the ex-NATO airfield into a new platform for full-freighter activities.
The opening of the airport is fixed for mid-1998 with the first all-cargo flights scheduled to operate from then or at the latest by the end-1998, Europort Vatry told Reuters earlier this year.
The project is targeting the major air cargo markets such as North America, the Far East, the Gulf States and Europe.

According to market surveys commissioned by Europort Vatry, the all-cargo airport could generate between 300,000 and 700,000 tonnes of air cargo annually by 2010. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
